General Manager

Category

Property Management

Overview

Federal Realty Investment Trust is a proven leader in the ownership, operation, and redevelopment of high-quality retail real estate in the country's best markets. We believe we are one of the most innovative and dynamic real estate companies you can work for. Interested candidates who research Federal hear a lot about our high-quality shopping centers and mixed-use centers. Our well-respected real estate team is at our core, but it's the smaller intangible things that can make working at Federal so satisfying. You see, while we're one of the largest publicly traded real estate investment trusts in the country, as measured by the value of our shopping centers, we're really a very small company by most standards and we try to operate that way. Our stability and success are due to our great team of employees! Would you like to join our team? If so, learn more about our current opportunity below.
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on real estate operations professional to join our team in the role of General Manager. The preferred candidate will possess excellent experience in property operations, facility management, vendor and contract management, tenant engagement, and project initiation. The position is based at Grossmont Center in La Mesa, California and will be responsible for the day-to-day operations of two properties: Grossmont Center, a 925,000-square-foot shopping center in La Mesa, and Escondido Promenade, a shopping center in Escondido. The General Manager will implement policies and procedures, set up controls and best practices, and be influential in the areas of operations, tenant relations, security, procurement, and risk management in order to achieve maximum productivity and profitability while maintaining the highest level of corporate standards. This role is also closely involved in the large-scale, multi-phase redevelopment currently underway at Grossmont Center, partnering with ownership, design, and construction teams to help keep the center fully operational throughout construction. The General Manager will oversee and supervise the in-house and contracted departments across both properties to ensure property goals are achieved. This role reports to the Senior Director, Asset Management.

Responsibilities

- Lead and manage on-site property personnel while developing and maintaining operational standards and procedures across both properties.
- Manage service providers and vendors responsible for the day-to-day operational needs of both properties, including repair and maintenance, landscaping, housekeeping, waste removal, contracted janitorial services, contracted security services, plumbing, roof, physical plant, and energy management systems, ensuring property standards are maintained.
- Perform regular site inspections at both properties to assess physical condition, compliance, and overall administration; ensure issues are addressed immediately and expectations are met.
- Stay closely involved in Grossmont Center's large-scale redevelopment, coordinating on-site with ownership, construction management, design teams, and outside contractors to help keep the project on track while maintaining a safe, welcoming environment for tenants and shoppers throughout construction.
- Develop and implement proactive strategies to resolve property operational and compliance-related challenges across both properties.
- Identify and recommend capital projects; create and maintain capital improvement plans while coordinating the specification, bidding, and execution of major maintenance projects and service agreements.
- Develop and maintain positive retail tenant relations by meeting with tenants at both properties on a regular basis; obtain tenant intel on sales and market comps. Resolve tenant issues that occur and serve as the primary point of contact for all merchant daily operating needs including general maintenance, tenant utilities, lease issues, trash concerns, and parking management.
- Read and interpret engineering and architectural drawings and schematic diagrams, as needed, particularly in support of the Grossmont Center redevelopment.
- Bid all contracts and capital purchases, and enlist, hire, and manage all contractors performing capital projects across both properties.
- Develop and review the annual operating budget and quarterly budget reforecast reports for both properties; monitor all purchases and expenses to ensure cost effectiveness and manage operating expenses within or below budgeted levels. Work with property accountants to prepare monthly variance reports and accruals and the finance team to forecast property level cash flows accurately for corporate planning and analysis.
- Assist with accounts receivable management via tenant phone contacts, in-person meetings, and collections across both properties; review and report status.
- Manage invoice processing, coding, and payment across both properties ensuring invoices are paid on time.
- Develop and maintain a system for tracking vendor insurance certificates for both properties.
- Submit or oversee routine property reporting, including activity reports, variance reports, site inspection reports, roof inspections, and lighting reports, in a timely manner.
- Collaborate and establish strong working relationships with key stakeholders including Marketing on the coordination of property events, Tenant Coordination to expedite completion of landlord work and delivery of spaces to tenants, and appropriate key civic and community leaders in both La Mesa and Escondido to ensure positive benefits for the properties.
- Assist the Senior Director, Asset Management on a daily basis with financial and capital management, fostering relationships both internal and external to the Company and support strategic initiatives to drive revenue and reduce expenses.
- Complete other special projects and duties as assigned from time to time.

Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in commercial real estate property management; previous roles should encompass at least 5 years of progressively increasing responsibility in P&L management, vendor contract oversight, and other key real estate functions. Experience managing retail shopping centers is strongly preferred.
- Bachelor's degree in business administration, real estate, or a related field.
- Experience managing multiple properties simultaneously and supporting active construction or redevelopment projects strongly preferred.
- Demonstrated experience budgeting, monitoring expenses, preparing monthly management and financial reports, and processing accounts payable.
- Previous direct responsibility for negotiating and monitoring maintenance projects and service contracts.
- Must possess ownership mentality which involves adopting a long-term ownership perspective in all aspects of the role.
- Must be capable of maintaining P&L ownership and accountability while pursuing well-defined objectives and strategies for achieving long-term goals.
- Proven track record of leadership, fostering high-performing teams, and cultivating a culture of success and profitability.
- Demonstrates adeptness in collaborative, cross-functional, and resourceful operations.
- Takes initiative, motivates others to align with project vision, and inspires confidence, energy, and trust.
- Driven to achieve objectives while maintaining personal accountability and honesty in communication.
- Exhibits strong oral and written communication proficiency with a focus on cultivating positive relationships with prospective and current tenants, and effectively collaborating with individuals across all organizational levels.
- Possesses financial acumen and advanced analytical capabilities.
- Proficient in developing and executing operational and capital expenditure budgets, adept at managing multiple complex projects simultaneously.
- Displays a keen business acumen and intellectual curiosity with the ability to formulate strategies and goals to support growth initiatives.
- Ability to lead teams in addressing operational challenges and understanding their financial implications.
- Exercises rational judgment in tough decisions and contributes to the development of best practices and performance assessment frameworks.
- Ability to perform essential on-site property inspections at both properties, including walking or standing for extended periods, with reasonable accommodations as needed.
- Thrives in an entrepreneurial environment, demonstrating urgency and a proactive approach.
- Willingness to take on various roles during periods of growth and change.
- Exhibits clear leadership qualities, excellent presentation, and written communication skills.
- Demonstrates alignment with Federal's mission, vision, and values.
- Utilizes technology to enhance project performance, access necessary information, and improve business processes and execution.
- Proficient in property management software and Microsoft Product Suite to include Excel and Word; knowledge of JDE and Nexus a plus but not required.

Salary Range: The typical total cash compensation range for this role is $155,000–$185,000 per year, inclusive of base salary and any applicable bonus. To ensure a fair and competitive offer, we take into account your job-related skills, experience, relevant trainings, and certifications.

Federal Realty Investment Trust is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer. Federal values a diverse workforce and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities to all employees and applicants. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity or expression, genetics, or protected Veteran status.

Federal Realty Investment Trust does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of Federal Realty Investment Trust and Federal Realty Investment Trust will not be obligated to pay a placement fee.

If you are unable to submit your application online, please call 301-998-8100.

Category

Finance

Overview

Federal Realty is a proven leader in the ownership, operation, development and redevelopment of premium retail real estate in the country's best markets. We are an innovative and dynamic real estate company that owns and manages a best-in-class portfolio of community shopping centers and mixed-use properties. Federal Realty’s well-respected real estate investment and management team delivers a significant combination of small and large scale, value-add investments that make working at Federal rewarding. While Federal Realty is one of the largest publicly traded real estate investment trusts in the country, as measured by the value of our assets, we're functionally a small company by most standards and we operate that way. Team members with initiative and proven ability get involved in many facets of executing Federal’s business plan.

Federal Realty is seeking a Financial Analyst for the Finance team to provide strategic, financial, and analytical support for its Maryland, Florida and Central portfolios. The Financial Analyst partners with Asset Management, Leasing, Operations, Construction and Development teams to provide financial support and apply an owner’s mindset to identify opportunities that grow income and create lasting value across the portfolio.

This is a unique opportunity to work in a hands-on team environment while gaining valuable experience in all facets of commercial real estate. This position is based in North Bethesda, Maryland, and is available on a hybrid basis: four days in office and one day remote each week.

Responsibilities

- Build, maintain, and analyze detailed income and cash flow projections for portfolio properties
- Manage pro forma financial analyses for ground-up developments and redevelopments
- Conduct variance analyses (actual vs. budget/forecast) and prepare NOI and periodic financial results reporting for senior management
- Provide market and competitive information to feed into project decisions for leasing, development and redevelopment opportunities and present findings to Senior Management
- Evaluate the financial impact of potential leasing, development, and redevelopment opportunities proactively identifying value-add and revenue growth opportunities
- Contribute to the creation of annual budgets and strategic business plans with data driven recommendations that help shape long-term portfolio strategy
- Prepare financial analyses and supporting material for Investment Committee memoranda
- Review prospective retail and office tenant financial performance to determine creditworthiness
- Prepare lease reviews including CAM and operating expense reconciliation and support
- Build and improve financial models and reporting tools
- Perform ad hoc analysis and special projects as requested

Qualifications

- 3-5 years’ experience in financial analyses and reporting (real estate preferred)
- Bachelor’s degree
- Solid understanding of financial valuation concepts (financial ratios, IRR, NPV, etc.)
- Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel
- Familiarity with Argus Enterprise is a plus
- Motivated, self-starter with the ability to work with minimal supervision and function in a team environment by effectively communicating and sharing information with people in other departments within the company
- Keen attention to accuracy and detail while under tight deadlines
- Highly organized and efficient with the proven ability to handle multiple projects, think creatively and set priorities

Salary Range: The typical base pay range is $110,000-$130,000 per year plus bonus. To ensure a fair and competitive offer, we take into account your job-related skills, experience, relevant education, certifications, and/or training.
